paragraphs.text: Jason Carthalion (JAY-sun kar-THAL-ee-un ), of the renowned Carthalion lineage , was a mighty hero from the Ice Age of Dominaria . He was a ward to Oriel Kjeldos , the champion of Clan Emerald of Storgard and a user of green mana .

Jason was orphaned at a young age when his parents were lost to the cold of the Ice Age . Oriel Kjeldos , leader of Clan Emerald , took him in as her ward. He grew up alongside Freyalise of Clan Ruby , who tutored him in ice magic.

In 2434 AR , King Miko called upon him to duel Freyalise as champion of Clan Emerald . Unbeknownst to most, Miko was manipulated in this by the vicious planeswalker Tevesh Szat ; Freyalise was by far the more powerful of the two. Yet in the end, Jason triumphed with the use of the Fyndhorn Bow and the Shield of the Ages . He fatally wounded Freyalise, who ascended . Impressed by Jason's decision to reject black mana, she converted to green as well.
Later, Jason left Storgard with Oriel Kjeldos and the others of his clan before the Fall of Storgard .

Seklistis was Jason Carthalion's bonded woolly spider during the Ice Age on on Dominaria . It was killed by Freyalise 's grizzled wolverine Kianon , although it did manage to avenge itself before it died, a victim of the duel between the two former friends at Storgard .

The Bow of the Nordic Warrior and the Shield of the Ice Prince , given to Jason before his duel with Freyalise by Oriel Kjeldos and Mariska , who had recovered the forbidden and enchanted weapons from Raynor Glacier .
